sources.finding: Published OJ S procurement notices are reusable for commercial and noncommercial purposes unless otherwise noted. Editorial content is CC BY 4.0; SIMAP system metadata is CC0 1.0. The disclaimer limits reliance and identifies electronically signed OJ S notices as authentic.
General reuse for commercial and noncommercial purposes without charge, subject to specified conditions and exceptions; source acknowledgement, preservation of meaning and non-liability may apply.
Published notice search is unauthenticated and explicitly intended for commercial added-value services as well as other reusers.

commercial_interpretation: A partner-side comparison against a minimal official reference can avoid redistributing competitor page content. This narrows the source-rights dependency, not a proof of record-specific clearance, buyer demand, source completeness, service cost or permission to deploy.
limitations: Historical fixed cohort; not live monitoring or a full Swedish procurement census.
Official Search projections are not authenticated signed notices, legal deadlines or complete amendment histories.
Do not treat all Search fields as CC0 system metadata or reuse third-party portals under TED terms.
No raw contact fields, buyer labels, titles or competitor observations are exported. Personal-data and record-specific rights remain separate.
No paid API calls, outreach, sensitive customer data or public deployment.
